hypothesis.statement: On a real 5-minute RR window (Fantasia f1y01, a young healthy adult), ecgHRVpoincare's SD1/SD2/ratio reproduce an independent from-scratch numpy implementation of the analytical closed-form (Brennan 2001, unbiased n-1 variance) BIT-FOR-BIT, and NeuroKit2 hrv_nonlinear: SD1 bit-for-bit (the universal SDSD/sqrt(2)); SD2 up to a documented ~0.2 ms convention (the op uses the analytical closed-form SD2^2 = 2*SDNN^2 - 0.5*SDSD^2; NeuroKit2 uses the geometric paired-projection std((RR_n+RR_n+1)/sqrt(2)), which an independent numpy paired projection reproduces bit-for-bit).

analysis_plan.dataset: Fantasia Database (PhysioNet), subject f1y01 (young healthy adult), the first 5-minute RR window (time <= 300 s, 392 RR intervals), RR in integer ms derived at 250 Hz

decision.threshold: descriptive: SD1/SD2/ratio equal an independent numpy analytical closed-form to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-10); SD1 equals NeuroKit2's SD1 to < 1e-9; the numpy paired-projection equals NeuroKit2's SD2 to < 1e-9 (identifying the SD2 convention); the op-vs-NeuroKit2 SD2 gap is a documented ~0.2 ms convention
